data.body:
Bookkeeping-gap closure segment (6 tickets):

Discovered 6 tickets (22ec, 6ba3, c181, 1c70, 2dbf, 852a) plus ecb4 had code
committed/pushed to Gerrit but never transitioned to closed. For each:
verified all ACs against real evidence (grep of merged code, test counts),
re-ran review-plan (re-rooted correctly in this worktree after a bash-script
cwd bug misdirected two earlier runs against the wrong checkout), and closed
once PASS.

Gerrit landing: changes 2538 (6ba3) and 2540 (c181) were already merged.
Changes 2541-2545 (1c70, ecb4, 2dbf, 852a, 22ec) reached LLM-Review +1 but
lacked Verified +1 until CI was triggered (run 33704193908, ~48min, all
jobs green including 4 pytest matrix jobs). Submitted stack top (2545) via
Gerrit REST API - all 5 merged to main atomically.

Closed in order as review-plan passed: 6ba3, c181, 1c70, 2dbf, 852a.

ecb4 post-merge review-plan found a genuine BLOCK: two JSON schema
`description` fields (plan_review_precheck_output.schema.json,
plan_review_verdict.schema.json) still said "P1-P9" instead of "P1-P11" -
missed by the original fix's grep sweep. Confirmed via git show against
origin/main this was real, not a stale-baseline false positive (unlike an
earlier false-positive BLOCK against 852a's not-yet-merged RCA test file).

Fixed RED-first: confirmed test_det_floor_seam_boundary_comments_keep_p1_p9_verbatim
protects det_advisory.py/det_lint.py's OWN "P1-P9" comments as intentionally
frozen (do not touch); only the two schema files were genuinely stale. Added
2 new regression tests to tests/unit/test_review_lifecycle_docs.py, confirmed
RED, applied the 2-line schema fix, confirmed GREEN (7 passed).

Hit shared pre-commit hook corruption (bug 84aa, documented in AGENTS.md):
another concurrent worktree's `make hooks` had overwritten the shared
.git/hooks/pre-commit to point at its own venv. Fixed via `make hooks` from
this worktree. Also fixed a line-length lint error and a commit-message
50/72-wrap violation.

Committed as 7e77bbb26e18 (rebar-ticket: ecb4 trailer, DCO sign-off).
Discovered worktree had diverged from origin/main (Gerrit Rebase-If-Necessary
rewrites merged commit SHAs) - resolved via git stash / reset --hard
origin/main / stash pop before committing.

Pushed as new Gerrit change 2554. CI run 33709530409 (~27min) passed;
LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1; submitted via REST - merged as 8047cafb4f60.
Synced worktree, re-ran review-plan ecb4 -> PASS. Updated ecb4's ticket
description with a "Follow-up" paragraph documenting the gap/fix/evidence.

First close attempt failed: file_impact didn't declare the 2 schema files
+ the test file touched by the follow-up commit (widening file_impact is a
MATERIAL plan change per rebar's own gate). Ran `rebar set-file-impact` to
add the 3 follow-up paths, re-ran review-plan (PASS again, verified_at_sha
matched the merged commit), then `rebar transition ecb4 in_progress closed`
succeeded.

All 6 previously-mistracked tickets (22ec, 6ba3, c181, 1c70, 2dbf, 852a) plus
ecb4 are now properly closed, matching their already-merged Gerrit changes.
Confirmed no orphaned background shells or OS processes remain from this
session's multiple backgrounded review-plan/CI-monitoring runs.

Next: resume epic 78f2-b104-e3c9-4b86 forward progress via
`rebar next-batch`/`rebar ready --epic` for the remaining ~33 unstarted
descendant tickets.
